summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a news release dated April 22, 2026, reporting final drilling results from 2025 at its Dropkick Zone on the Queensway Gold Project in Newfoundland and Labrador. The release provides assay highlights from step-out and expansion drilling, confirming continuity of high-grade gold mineralization. No corporate transaction, shareholder vote, or special situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic report of operational updates by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or recommendations mentioned. The filing is purely exploratory and not a special situation.
